root_cause: PersonaRegistryHttpWritePort.update_persona read lifecycle=draft, PATCHed metadata, then PATCHed /lifecycle draft->research_only. Two controllers (operator reconcile route and background loop, enabled by #6929) both read draft; the loser's lifecycle PATCH was rejected by the persona owner (422, same-state) and surfaced as 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.
fix: On a 400/409/422 rejection of the lifecycle PATCH the port re-reads the owner; if lifecycle_state is already the mapped target (research_only) it returns the readback as success. Any other rejection (readback not the target, or readback missing) re-raises the original error unchanged. The owner lifecycle guard and scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py are untouched.
